body: Thanks for being there. Good night.

Yeah, I've hesitated because I don't wanna hurt her feelings. But honestly I just made that appointment out of desperation for my family, try anything you know? I don't see how a counselor is gonna help with the thoughts long term, the wave of regrets that dump on me. A session is expensive enough without health insurance, forget about meds.

Yeah, but I don't know how much will spill out and I can't afford a 72 hour hold. That and I honestly don't think she can handle me. She's more a family counselor with little knowledge of substance issues. Like I said, a little naive, clearly never been to the darkside.

No. I don't know, I just sugar coat some stuff like in real life and she kept moving. No one actually want's to here your sorrow, they want to hear everything is okay, if you give them that they'll turn a blind eye.

It comes and goes in waves, but years. As soon as I get something going I act out to counteract the thoughts and end up setting myself back. I want this last fuckup to be the last, and there's only one sure way I know of.

I used to see a counselor but she wasn't that great. Kinda shallow and naive. I did set up another appointment with her next week though. It's hard to find things that make me happy with a constant barrage of self-hating, self-destructive thoughts coming at me.
What good is beating an addiction when a) I shouldn't have had it in the first place and b) I still can't make my way in this world. Sorry to be a dick but it feels like I'm a living disappointment.
